verdict.rationale: Sentry ships Seer, a built-in AI debugging agent and code reviewer. Users can hand it root-cause analysis and fix generation through Autofix, and from Seer they can launch connected coding agents (Cursor Cloud Agents, Copilot) to create pull requests. That is genuine in-product delegation, though Seer is a paid add-on. Missing for 10: evidence of delegating tasks beyond debugging and code review (no general conversational assistant shown), detailed first-party docs on how delegation works, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Seer's results.
